title: BrainGate · Utah-array recording yield
summary: Published array-level measurements from 2,289 research sessions, covering 20 Utah arrays in 14 BrainGate participants. Each plotted point is one measured array-session.

metrics.label: Electrode yield
metrics.definition: 100 × n_spiking_electrodes / 96. An electrode meets the authors' criterion when its robust threshold-crossing rate at −4.5 times robust standard deviation is at least 2 Hz. This is an array-level summary, not a neuron count.

metrics.label: Spiking electrodes
metrics.definition: Number of electrodes meeting the ≥2 Hz robust threshold-crossing-rate criterion at the −4.5 threshold; denominator is 96 electrodes per array.

metrics.label: Median impedance
metrics.definition: Median across array electrodes, excluding impedance values ≥4000 kΩ. Null indicates unavailable measurements; the source does not give a universal measurement frequency in this summary.

metrics.label: Median negative waveform peak
metrics.definition: Median of the minimum value of each spiking electrode's mean threshold-crossing waveform. Negative sign retained. This is one scalar per array-session, not waveform samples.

metrics.label: Mean noise threshold
metrics.definition: Mean voltage threshold at −3 times robust standard deviation across the included spiking electrodes. A negative threshold, not an RMS noise amplitude.

metrics.label: Authors' waveform ratio
metrics.definition: Median negative waveform peak divided by mean negative noise threshold. Both numerator and denominator are negative, giving a positive ratio. This is the authors' specific SNR definition, not generic peak-to-peak/RMS SNR.

provenance.citation: Hahn NV, Stein E, BrainGate Consortium, Donoghue JP, Simeral JD, Hochberg LR, Willett FR (2026). Performance of intracortical microelectrode arrays in people with implanted brain-computer interfaces over a 20-year period.
provenance.sourceLicense: MIT (authors' code repository, including distributed summary CSV); underlying Dryad dataset CC0-1.0
provenance.transformation: All 3,757 source rows preserved. Columns renamed to explicit units; blank CSV cells converted to null. Values parsed to JSON numbers without rounding, interpolation, smoothing, or recalculation. Rows grouped by participant and array, then sorted by implantation day.

limitations: These are published summary measurements, not continuous electrode voltages, per-electrode channel maps, waveform samples, or a live decoder.

Days are relative to each participant's implantation and sampling intervals differ. The data do not follow every implant continuously, and a study spanning 20 years does not mean 20 years of follow-up for each array.
Recordings under different participants, tasks and acquisition conditions are not a controlled device comparison. No clinical performance prediction or device lifespan estimate is computed.
Missing impedance or waveform metrics stay null and should be shown as unavailable; do not connect a curve through missing values.
